[[File:2023 Retro League banner.png|thumb|right|2023 Retro League banner]]
The '''2023 Retro League''' was the second season of the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. [[Steve Sanders]] was the tournament director, assisted by [[Jared Napolitano]]. Entry became a flat $10 fee.<ref name="pc2023" /> 68 players took part.<ref name="t82168" />

== Changes from 2022 ==
Premiere - A New Hope was dropped and Premiere - Endor added. Premiere - Reflections II banned [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]].<ref name="pc2023" /><ref name="t82168" /> Between Events 2 and 3 the league paused for the [[2023 Online Retro Event]], a separate Players Committee charity tournament.<ref name="t82168" />

== Events ==

* '''Format:''' various, one per event: [[Premiere - Hoth]], [[Premiere - Endor]], [[Premiere - Death Star II]], [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]], [[Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)]]
Each event was six weekly games of Swiss, scored by strength of schedule.<ref name="t82168" />

== Final standings ==
[[Paul Todd Feldman]] won the league for the second straight year.<ref name="t82168" /> [[Brad Kippel]], [[Timo Dusel]] and [[Andrew Bethell]] received the prizes for 2nd to 4th place.<ref name="t82155" />


The league winner's grand prize was a Premiere Dark Side black border rare uncut sheet, and each full participant received a pair of snap pins.<ref name="pc2023" /><ref name="t82155" /> Another uncut sheet was awarded at random from the pool of diligent players.<ref name="t82155" />
